test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The sculpture's **patina** conveyed a sense of antiquity.

options.text: The vase developed a green patina from oxidation.
Her reputation had the patina of elegance.
The copper roof bore a classic patina.
Patina formed due to prolonged exposure to salt air.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Her reputation had the patina of elegance." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"patina"** has multiple meanings and can refer to: • A thin layer that forms on the surface of metals (such as bronze or copper) due to oxidation over time, giving it an antique look. (जंग या धातु पर परत) • A superficial or external appearance that suggests elegance or refinement. (बाहरी चमक या छवि) • **Example (First Meaning): **The vase developed a green patina from oxidation. • **Example (Second Meaning): **Her reputation had the patina of elegance. • In the context of the question, the sentence "Her reputation had the patina of elegance" refers to the second meaning — an external impression or refinement associated with her reputation. (बाहरी छवि या प्रतिष्ठा) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The vase developed a green patina from oxidation. (विकल्प 1: जंग के कारण हरे रंग की परत बन गई।) • This option refers to the first meaning of "patina," i.e., a layer formed on metal surfaces due to oxidation. It is correct in its context but does not match the highlighted meaning in the question. • **Option 3:** The copper roof bore a classic patina. (विकल्प 3: तांबे की छत पर एक क्लासिक परत थी।) • Here, "patina" again refers to the first meaning, where a layer develops on copper due to oxidation. It is correct in its context but does not fit the highlighted meaning in the sentence. • **Option 4:** Patina formed due to prolonged exposure to salt air. (विकल्प 4: नमकीन हवा के लंबे समय तक संपर्क के कारण परत बन गई।) • This option also refers to the first meaning of "patina," i.e., the layer formed on a surface due to environmental factors. While correct, it does not match the intended meaning in the sentence. fb:Tbc6, The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The farmer tilled the entire tract before sowing.**.
